# F.I.R.S.T. Institute

> > F.I.R.S.T. Institute is a Florida-based digital media career training school offering programs in audio engineering, film production, graphic design, and web development.

Located in Orlando, F.I.R.S.T. Institute provides hands-on training in recording arts, music production, video production, motion graphics, and UI/UX design. The institute features industry-experienced faculty and has placed graduates at major companies including Universal Studios, Disney, ABC, and NFL.

## Key Topics

- Audio Engineering
- Recording Arts
- Music Production
- Film & Video Production
- Graphic Design
- Web Development
- Motion Graphics
- UI/UX Design
- Show Production
- Career Training
- Orlando Campus
- Graduate Success Stories
- Digital Media Education
- Industry Partnerships
- Hands-on Learning

## Programs & Applications

- [Student Application](https://www.first.edu/apply): Online application form for F.I.R.S.T. Institute digital media programs
- [Recording Arts School](https://www.first.edu/programs/audio-engineering-music-production-school): Audio engineering & music production program with live show, mixing training
- [Graphic Design School](https://www.first.edu/programs/graphic-design-school): 10-month graphic design & web development program with UI/UX, motion graphics

- [Film and Video Production Career Paths](https://www.first.edu/your-career/film-and-video-production-career-paths): Overview of film & video production careers from commercials to TV/movies

- [How To Become a Film Director](https://www.first.edu/blog/film-video-industry/how-to-become-a-film-director-what-does-a-film-director-actually-do): Film director career guide covering role, process, and filmmaking education
- [F.I.R.S.T. Institute: Web & Graphic Design Courses](https://www.first.edu/blog/graphic-design-industry/f-i-r-s-t-institute-web-graphic-design-courses): Web & graphic design program overview with ABC, Disney, NFL alumni success

- [What is Shutter Speed, ISO, and Aperture?](https://www.first.edu/blog/digital-photography/what-is-shutter-speed-iso-and-aperture): Photography fundamentals: shutter speed, ISO, aperture settings explained
